## Development Plan

### Priority 1: Nested PowerShell Script Preservation (MODERATE ~3h)
**Category**: tool (bash, PowerShell invocation)  
**Source**: Cline #13815 (2026-09-10 research carry-forward)

Port Cline's nested PowerShell unwrapping logic to prevent variable interpolation bugs when users or models wrap PowerShell commands in PowerShell. Currently `powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*.ts' }"` fails because the outer bootstrap interpolates `$_` before the inner script sees it.

**Files to modify:**
- `src/tool/tools/bash.ts` — add `unwrapNestedPowerShell()` helper, wire into PowerShell execution path
- `src/tool/tools/__tests__/bash-powershell.test.ts` (new) — test nested invocation unwrapping

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Detects standalone `powershell`/`pwsh` with `-NoProfile` and single/double-quoted `-Command` body
- Decodes script text (strip outer quotes, unescape inner quotes) and runs through existing UTF-8 stdin bootstrap
- Test: `ax chat -m "run: powershell -Command \"Get-ChildItem | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*.ts' }\""` succeeds on Windows
- Verify `$_` variables preserved in single-quoted and double-quoted forms
- Non-matching invocations (e.g. `-File`, multiple flags) pass through unchanged
- Cancellation (Ctrl+C) still works

### Priority 2: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Model Support (SMALL ~1h)
**Category**: provider (model catalog, DeepSeek)  
**Source**: OpenCode #48270 (2026-09-10 research carry-forward)

Add `deepseek-v4.1-flash` to model catalog for users who want cheaper/faster reasoning model alternative. SAP AI Core may already have deployed it, but Alexi's catalog doesn't include the entry.

**Files to modify:**
- `src/providers/modelCatalog.ts` — add `deepseek-v4.1-flash` to static model list with reasoning capability profile
- `src/providers/__tests__/modelCatalog.test.ts` — add test case for V4.1 Flash

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Model added to static `ORCHESTRATION_MODELS` list with same reasoning profile as `deepseek-v4-chat` (reasoning: levels, budget: reasoning_effort)
- Test: `ax chat --model deepseek-v4.1-flash -m "test"` succeeds (mock if SAP deployment unavailable)
- Verify reasoning: `ax chat --model deepseek-v4.1-flash --reasoning-effort high -m "explain bubble sort"` emits reasoning blocks
- Coverage >= 40%
